columns: wide
fig-width: 6.5
toc-expand: 3
format:
  html:
    fig-dpi: hi
    fig-width: 300
execute:
  daemon: banana
  daemon-restart: true
---

Prose body. The FOUR wrong NUMERIC values above each render exit 1 at the
`quarto render` 1.7.33 YAML-SCHEMA layer ("…which must instead be a number"):
`columns: wide` (top-level number), `format.html.fig-dpi: hi` (per-format number),
`execute.daemon: banana` (nested number-OR-boolean), and the cell `#| layout-ncol: two`
below (cell-metadata number). The rest are VALID and must NEVER be flagged:
`fig-width: 6.5` / `format.html.fig-width: 300` (valid numbers), `toc-expand: 3`
(number-OR-boolean, number form), `execute.daemon-restart: true` (valid boolean),
and the cell `#| fig-width: 3` (valid number). Numeric validation reaches all four
surfaces through the SHARED `isWrongValue` matcher — no new loop (numeric plan §3.1).

```{r}
#| layout-ncol: two
#| fig-width: 3
1 + 1
```
